Kimberly / team — initial redline notes below (high level). I attached a party-sheet (party-sheet-crestline.xlsx) with contact and signer info they included in the Order Form. Full tracked redline PDF will follow by EOD.

Top-line:
- Residency: propose adding clause in Section 3.2: "Customer data will be processed and stored in data centers located in the United States; any transfer outside the United States requires prior written consent." Crestline asked for US-only — recommending to accept but add feed for emergency exception with strict audit trail.
- Subprocessors: add Exhibit X with our current subprocessors and a 30-day notice obligation for new ones. Do not accept unlimited right to engage without notice.
- SLA for bulk ingestion: Crestline wants a firm window. Propose two options in Order Form: (A) Standard — 95% of bulk jobs processed within 6 hours (no additional fee); (B) Premium — 95% within 2 hours (premium SLA fee / reserved capacity). Jordan, can you confirm pricing delta for (B)?
- IP: we should keep our standard model-output ownership language but add carveouts for de-identified clinical datasets; propose a mutual confidentiality reinforcement for any derived clinical model artifacts.

Attachments: party-sheet-crestline.xlsx (Excel) — includes legal contact, billing contact, signing authority, and technical POC.

Marissa Cole
Senior Contracts Manager, Redwood Inference
